# LeJus Blog

LeJus's blog, hosted on GitHub Pages.

- **Blog URL:** https://akqjq1000.github.io/LeJus-Blog/
- **Topics:** cybersecurity, network monitoring, packet capture, low-level security research
- **Structure:** posts live in `_posts/`, rendered by Jekyll (GitHub Pages default)

## Local development

```bash
# Clone
git clone https://github.com/akqjq1000/LeJus-Blog.git

# Build locally with Jekyll (optional preview)
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

## Publishing

Add a new post in `_posts/`, commit, and push to `main`. GitHub Pages builds automatically.
